reuse.why: Every month-wide action and the new last-month-spending action go through isWrittenByMonthAction and toAverageBudgetAmount, and the tag check reuses extractTagsFromText; the new action borrows the 'average' variant and averaging sign helper rather than having a named variant of its own.

duplication.why: The per-action income/hidden/sign checks are collapsed into one predicate; the remaining repetition is the flag projection (goal_def IS NOT NULL, group note join) written into both getBudgetData's and getCategoriesWithGroupHidden's SQL.

placement.why: The selection rule and helpers sit in server/budget/actions.ts beside the actions, and the new method is registered in budget/app.ts like its siblings.

scope.why: Changes cover only the refactor, the exclusion rules, the new action and the hidden-categories flag, with tests.

maintainability.why: Later rule changes (templates, #fixed, includeHidden) each landed as one edit in the shared predicate; the 'copy'/'zero'/'average' action variant makes the preserved group-null difference explicit, though reusing 'average' for last-month spending is a slight naming stretch.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions (copyPreviousMonth, setZero, set3/6/12MonthAvg, setLastMonthSpending) call isWrittenByMonthAction.

disguised_duplication.where: The only overlap is the openly repeated flag columns/joins in the two SQL queries; no logic is renamed or reshaped to hide a copy.

abstraction_drift.where: isWrittenByMonthAction gained includeHiddenCategories over the steps and carries one 'average' branch (group must exist) that preserves an original inconsistency; no call site re-implements the rule.
